description: Returns the full text of one of four MIT-licensed playbooks (agent skills) for people who market health clinics, so the assistant can follow the method step by step: meta_ads_access_audit (who owns and controls a clinic's Meta ad account, Page, Instagram, dataset and WhatsApp), health_ad_compliance (reviewing an ad or landing page against Meta and Google policies and the health-advertising rules of Spain, the UK, the US and Australia; add country for that country's rules), lead_follow_up (a WhatsApp, SMS and call follow-up system for new enquiries) and care_plan_conversion (first visit, report of findings, care plans and retention). Each playbook says when its rules were checked.

country.description: Only for health_ad_compliance: also return that country's rules (es Spain, uk United Kingdom, us United States, au Australia).

topic.description: Which playbook: meta_ads_access_audit (who owns and controls a clinic's Meta ads setup), health_ad_compliance (reviewing an ad, post or landing page against Meta and Google policies and health-advertising rules), lead_follow_up (answering and following up new patient enquiries) or care_plan_conversion (first visits, care plans and keeping patients).

name: get_clinic_marketing_playbook

country.description: The country whose rules file the text includes (health_ad_compliance only); otherwise null

files.description: The files in the text, in order, each with the URL it is published at

skill.description: The agent skill the text comes from

title: Get a clinic marketing playbook
